title: MCOICOP
description: This table provides a complete lookup for 2, 3, 4, and 5-digit codes under Malaysia's COICOP (Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose), as applied and used in data publications in Malaysia. The MCOICOP is primarily used by the Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM), for instance when categorising and analysing consumer price inflation.

fields.name: digits
fields.title: Digits
fields.description: [Integer] Number of digits; this column can be used as a filter if you only want to keep 2 digit codes, for example

fields.name: division
fields.title: Division
fields.description: [String] 2-digit code; please ensure that you read this column as a string, because the (intentional) leading zeroes will be dropped if read as an integer (e.g. upon opening in Microsoft Excel)

fields.name: group
fields.title: Group
fields.description: [String] 3-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2-digit definitions)

fields.name: class
fields.title: Class
fields.description: [String] 4-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2 and 3-digit definitions)

fields.name: subclass
fields.title: Subclass
fields.description: [String] 5-digit code, with dashes where not applicable (e.g. for rows providing 2 and 3-digit definitions)

fields.name: desc_en
fields.title: Description (EN)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in English

fields.name: desc_bm
fields.title: Description (BM)
fields.description: [String] Description for the code, in Malay

methodology: The MCOICOP was adapted from the [latest COICOP published by the United Nations Statistics Division](https://unstats.un.org/unsd/classifications/Econ), which is used as a global reference in the classification of individual and household consumption.
